# External Comparative Evaluation — Reviewer Form

Fill one form per scenario. Save as `reviewer-<YOUR-ID>-<SCENARIO>.md` (e.g.
`reviewer-R2-X04.md`). Your ID is assigned to you; do not use your real name on the form.

## Reviewer metadata (fill once, repeat on every form)

- Reviewer ID: `R__` (assigned)
- Role (one): Senior PM / Principal or GPM / Director or VP / Founder / AI PM
- Years in product: ___
- Primary product model: B2B / consumer / marketplace / developer tool / platform / AI product / other
- Date: ___

## Scenario: X__  (no other scenario identifier needed)

| 10. Willingness to reuse | | | |
